summary: Frontend-only E2E test of iteration 4 — 4 ENHANCEMENTS (Path Compare, Case Export/pins-report, Source Health + Re-sync, View Thumbnails) + ~14 NEW SCREENS (Impact, Query, Changes, Incidents, Ontology, Quality, Agents, Reports, Snapshots, Governance, Tenant, Health, Settings, Help) + regression on prior flows. ALL FEATURES PASS. No blocking bugs. ENHANCEMENT 1 — Path Compare (/graph → graph-mode-paths): Set path-source=EOIP-1, path-target=service.py, path-target-b=README.md and clicked path-run (Compare). The path-compare panel appeared top-right showing 'BLAST SURFACE COMPARE' with 'TARGET A: 3 paths, min 3 hops · 6 nodes', 'TARGET B: 1 paths, min 1 hops · 2 nodes', and '2 shared nodes on both surfaces'. The paths-list panel (bottom-left) rendered '3 SHORTEST PATHS' with path chips (EOIP-1 → README.md → 3d9ab57f... → service.py), the stats chip shows '3 paths' in cyan, and the merged graph highlights path nodes (demo blue, 42 cyan, README.md green, META grey, service.py cyan) over dimmed context (62 nodes, 69 edges total). Verified via screenshot /app/.screenshots/path_compare_v2.png. ENHANCEMENT 2 — Case Export / pins-report (/ask): Ran 'What implements EOIP-1?', 4 evidence items rendered each with ask-evidence-pin-{0..3}. Clicked ask-evidence-pin-0 → right-side Evidence Board panel opened with pins-copy, pins-export, pins-report buttons (all three visible). Clicked pins-report → downloaded 'kgf-case-report-2026-10-16.md' with the content '# Evidence Case Report / _Generated 10/16/2026 · KnowGridFlow_ / **1 pinned fact** across 1 question. / ## What implements EOIP-1? / 1. {"edge_id":...,...}' — valid Markdown case report. ENHANCEMENT 3 — Source Health + Re-sync (/ingestion → Sources): 2 registered source-row-* found (demo-web-1 + the TEST source left over from iteration_3), each with a source-resync-{id} button. Clicked source-resync-demo-web-1 → POST /sources/{id}/sync fired and Jobs tab was auto-selected (verified by DOM state and body text post-click). ENHANCEMENT 4 — View Thumbnails (/graph → Views): Saved view 'TEST_thumb_abc' via graph-views-trigger → graph-view-name → graph-view-save. A thumbnail appeared in the saved views list with src='data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AA…' (62x34 px) — confirms canvasRef.getThumbnail() 2D readback is embedded in the saved-view row. NEW SCREENS (all verified): - /impact: impact-search 'service' returned 6 results; clicking impact-result → impact-result-panel visible (shows Risk badge, Total affected, depth bars, type chips from /graph/blast-radius). - /query: query-input prefilled with 'find all requirements'; query-run → query-result renders rows. - /changes: 'Recent changes' section renders with change list from /change-journal. - /incidents: incident-new modal opened → filled title/desc → incident-create POST → 'TEST_incident_abc' appears in list. - /ontology: tabs overview, validation, drift, packs all render. - /quality: tabs debt, freshness, duplicates, contradictions all render. - /agents: tabs agents, proposals, loops, recovery all render. - /reports: 5 report-render buttons found; clicking first renders report-output JSON via /reports/render. - /snapshots: snapshot-create with name 'TEST_snap_xyz' creates and lists it; snapshot-restore opens a typed-confirmation modal with snapshot-confirm-input. - /governance: tabs posture, roles, egress all render (egress shows 'No egress endpoints — Local only' empty state as expected). - /tenant: Context / Quotas / Feature flags panels render. - /health: Capabilities / Gap / Model readiness tiles + Health aggregate + System panel render. - /settings: settings-theme-light actually switches document.documentElement from 'dark' → 'light' (verified). - /help: Demo / About / Notifications sections render. SIGN-OUT: principal-menu-trigger → signout-button → returns to /signin (verified). REGRESSION: sign-in with pre-filled bearer + 'Continue' (signin-submit-button) works; Overview stats '226 vertices / 721 edges' render; nav rail GROUPED into Workspace / Explore / Knowledge / Operate / Govern / System as per spec. NOTE: 2–3 console 401s on /signin are harmless (auth verify-then-fallback), as previously documented.
critical_code_review_comments: GraphExplorer.tsx is ~800 lines and growing — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting EntityPicker, the Paths/Compare panel, Views popover, and canvas-mode state into dedicated files to keep review surface small.

EntityPicker dropdown options do NOT expose a data-testid for each result row (lines 107–122). This forced the test to click by visible text instead of a stable selector. Adding data-testid={`${testId}-option-${idx}`} on the <button> would make path-source/target/target-b wiring deterministic for automation.
The TEST source created in iteration_3 (web-test-714348 style id, if present) persists in the demo backend — not a bug, but future tests should idempotently create or clean up test sources.

Governance screen renders 'No egress endpoints — Local only' as a correct empty state; good UX pattern that should be mirrored in Agents/proposals, Snapshots, Incidents when empty (already done — verified).

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 enhancements + 14/14 new screens + regression — all pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 enhancements and 14 new screens pass end-to-end against the real EOIP backend. EntityPicker options have no per-row testid — click by visible text (e.g., page.locator('button:has-text("README.md")').first). Pins Panel: ask-evidence-pin-N opens the right-side Evidence Board automatically; pins-report / pins-copy / pins-export are all in the panel header. View thumbnail is embedded as data:image/jpeg;base64 in the saved-view row . Signin button testid is signin-submit-button (NOT signin-continue). Session is in-memory only — always use app-shell-nav-* clicks after sign-in, never page.goto() to authed routes. Expected harmless console 401s on /signin from auth verify-then-fallback + /auth/health.
rca of the issue: No functional issues to RCA this iteration. Only maintainability note: GraphExplorer.tsx is approaching the 700-line soft limit — recommend extracting EntityPicker + the Paths/Compare side panels + Views popover into sub-modules.
